utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Will the Registrar call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is the case number IT-05-88-A, the Prosecutor versus Vujadin Popovic et al.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. And the appearances, beginning with the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. ELMORE
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Elizabeth Elmore on behalf of the Prosecution. I'm here today with Senior Appeals Counsel Barbara Goy and Case Manager Janet Stewart.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. And the Defence for Mr. Popovic.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. TAPUSKOVIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is Mira Tapuskovic. I am co-counsel for Vujadin Popovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Beara.

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTOJIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. Good afternoon. John Ostojic on behalf of Ljubisa Beara.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Miletic.

utterances.speaker: MS. FAUVEAU
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Natacha Fauveau Ivanovic for Radovan Miletic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. And Mr. Pandurevic.

utterances.speaker: MR. HAYNES
utterances.text: Your Honour, Peter Haynes for Vinko Pandurevic. Good afternoon.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. Let me begin first with a summary of the recent decisions issued by the Appeals Chamber in this case. Well, I'll just check. The counsel for Mr. Nikolic is here?

utterances.speaker: MS. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Thank you. I'm Jelena Nikolic, attorney and Defence counsel for Dragan Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you very much. I was about to provide a summary of the recent decisions issued by the Appeals Chamber in this case. On the 22nd of July, 2014, the Chamber issued a public decision dismissing Mr. Popovic's sixth motion under Rule 115. On the 3rd of September, 2014, the Chamber issued a public decision dismissing Mr. Nikolic's fourth motion under Rule 115. And yesterday the Chamber issued a Scheduling Order for the public pronouncement of the appeal judgement in the Popovic et al. case on Friday, 30 January 2015, 10.00 a.m. I now provide a summary of the status of the pending motions and decisions before the Appeals Chamber. We are currently seized of: One, a motion filed by Mr. Popovic, a seventh under Rule 115, filed on the 8th November 2013. The Prosecution's response and Mr. Popovic's reply have been received by the Appeals Chamber, and the motion remains under consideration by the Chamber. Two, a motion filed by Mr. Pandurevic for provisional release, filed on the 29th July 2014. Prosecution's response has been received, and the motion remains under consideration by the Chamber. That is the summary of pending motions. And if there are any matters to be raised by counsel, we can do that after I've heard from the appellants on the status of their health. May I now ask the appellants whether they wish to raise any concerns regarding their health or the conditions of their detention? Mr. Popovic. THE APPELLANT POPOVIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, there are no problems. For the most part, everything is all right.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Mr. Beara. THE APPELLANT BEARA: [Interpretation] I don't have any either proposals or requests. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Miletic. THE APPELLANT MILETIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I have no proposals, and my health is satisfactory.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Very good. Mr. Pandurevic. THE APPELLANT PANDUREVIC: [Interpretation] Your Honour, no new queries. Everything is all right. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And counsel for Mr. Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: MS. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour. Everything is fine with the health of Mr. Nikolic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you. And may I now ask whether there are any additional matters to be raised by the Prosecution or any of the Defence counsel?

utterances.speaker: MS. ELMORE
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. We have nothing to raise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes. Anything from the Defence counsel? I see a shaking of heads. There being no other matters, the hearing is adjourned.
